desc:
🌲 THE PRAN: Survive the Thai Ghosts

By day, you prepare. By night, the ghosts come out.

Team up with up to 3 friends and head into the forest. Hunt animals, chop wood, mine iron, and make your stand on a tree-top platform. Keep the campfire burning, because when darkness falls, the ghosts come from every direction. The longer you survive, the stronger they get.

⚔️ FIGHT BACK
Wield a machete, a double-barrel shotgun, and a pickaxe. Use the machete’s skill to dash in and tear through anything around you, structures included. Hold block to cut the damage you take.

🔥 GATHER, UPGRADE, GROW
Collect meat, wood, and iron from hunting and chopping. Trade at the shop, enhance your weapons, and roll for Perks, powers that range from Common up to shimmering rainbow Legendary.

🏕️ THE LOBBY
Gather your team before each run. Shop, enhance, roll Perks, and redeem codes.
Play alone if you dare, but you’ll last longer with friends.
